eventDetail.scope: The IEEE International Conference on Smart Innovations for Medicine and Engineering has a broad and interdisciplinary scope, covering cutting-edge advancements in Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Biomedical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Robotics, Cybersecurity, Smart Systems, and Healthcare Technologies. The conference aims to bridge the gap between engineering innovations and medical applications, fostering collaborations between academia, industry, and healthcare professionals.
